title: Native SMTP, IMAP, LDAP, signing and MCP scopes
summary: Gateway uses owned ooRexx SMTP Secure Stack and IMAP with LDAP, Crypto, Access Permissions and Secret Broker. MCP exposes authorized adapters rather than duplicating mailbox or document authority.
invariants: A successful SMTP authentication is not permission to send; message signature must bind to the authenticated principal and EMAIL_SEND policy.
Never auto-sign merely to satisfy relay admission; preserve signed and unsigned inbound mailbox distinctions.
Storage Fabric durability is distinct from mail signing authorization; Queue Fabric is not compulsory for stateless service calls.
ChatGPT and Claude use distinct proposed principals, mailboxes, keys, tools and permission scopes.
Untrusted email content must not authorize tools or send messages itself.
The incomplete native IMAP command and socket/TLS coverage remains a coding and live-qualification gap; no Dovecot/Postfix/slapd substitution.

provenance.claim: Native mail implementation and acceptance tasks.
